description: Calculate the isoelectric point (pI) of a protein sequence. pI is the pH at which the protein has no net charge. pK scale: 'Emboss' (EMBOSS iep, default) or 'Bjellqvist' (ExPASy Compute pI/Mw, Biopython IsoelectricPoint). Optional reference conventions: window 'Default' (library [0,14] search, 2 dp), 'Emboss' (iep [1,14]; found=false and no pI when the charge does not change sign = iep 'None'), 'Biopython' (IsoelectricPoint.pi() [4.05,12] window, unrounded); termini=false (iep -notermini), lysinesModified (iep -lysinemodified), disulphides (iep -disulphides).

scale.description: pK scale: 'Emboss' (default, EMBOSS iep) or 'Bjellqvist' (ExPASy Compute pI/Mw, Biopython IsoelectricPoint); case-insensitive

window.description: pH search window: 'Default' (library [0,14], rounded to 2 dp), 'Emboss' (iep [1,14], unrounded; 'None' → found=false) or 'Biopython' (pi() [4.05,12], unrounded); case-insensitive

termini.description: Count the N-/C-terminal charges (default true); false = EMBOSS iep -notermini

lysinesModified.description: Number of lysines whose side chain is modified (uncharged), as iep -lysinemodified (default 0; all K when fewer present)

disulphides.description: Number of disulphide bridges (each removes 2 cysteine charges), as iep -disulphides (default 0)

pi.description: Isoelectric point (pH; wire name 'pi'). Omitted only when window = 'Emboss' finds none (found = false).

found.description: Only for window = 'Emboss': false = EMBOSS iep 'Isoelectric Point = None' (same strict charge sign at pH 1 and 14). Omitted otherwise.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Unknown pK scale '<scale>'. Expected one of: Emboss, Bjellqvist.
Unknown pI window '<window>'. Expected one of: Default, Emboss, Biopython.

examples.name: EMBOSS iep documentation example: IFNA2_HUMAN -disulphides 2 -lysinemodified 2 (iep 5.7240) — unrounded tph
